description: Retrieve real-time ultrasound packages, scan durations, prices in South African Rand (ZAR), and full inclusions (thermal prints, high-definition digital videos/photos sent to phone, baby heartbeat recording). When to use: Call this tool when you specifically need to execute 'get_scan_packages_and_pricing' on Bump to Baby Store (bumptobabysa.co.za). Do NOT use this tool when another specialized tool fits better (use 'get_studio_info' or 'get_gestational_guide' or 'check_booking_availability' for their respective operations). Parameters: package_type (optional). Behavior & Side Effects: Strictly read-only, idempotent query with zero state mutation; public unauthenticated access allowed; rate-limited to 60 requests/min per IP. Returns: Structured JSON object containing status, matched records or computed metrics, and canonical action URLs.

package_type.description: Filter by package category. Optional, defaults to "all".
